1983: inducted to the Songwriters Hall of Fame. [ 152 ] 1984: received an Academy Award for Best Song for " I Just Called to Say I Love You " from the movie The Woman in Red. [ 206 ] 1989: inducted to the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame. [ 151 ] 1994: Star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame. [ 207 ] 1999: received the Polar Music Prize [ 153 ] and Kennedy Center Honors. [ 208 ] 2002: received the George and Ira Gershwin Lifetime Achievement Award at UCLA's Spring Sing. [ 209 ] The same year, Wonder received the Sammy Cahn Lifetime Achievement Award from the Songwriters Hall of Fame. [ 210 ] 2004: received the Billboard Century Award. [ 211 ] Also in 2004, Rolling Stone ranked him No. 15 on their list of the 100 Greatest Rock and Roll Artists of All Time. [ 212 ] 2006: was inducted, as one of the first inductees, into the Michigan Walk of Fame. [ 213 ] 2006: Recipient of a Lifetime Achievement Award from the National Civil Rights Museum in Memphis. [ 214 ] 2008: Ranked at number five on "The Billboard Hot 100 Top All-Time Artists", making him as the third most successful male artist in the history of Billboard Hot 100 chart. [ 215 ] February 23, 2009: Recipient of the Library of Congress's second Gershwin Prize For Popular Song, honored by U.S. President Barack Obama at the White House. [ 216 ] [ 217 ] 2009: Recipient of the Montreal Jazz Festival Spirit Award. [ 157 ] This special award underlines a popular artist's extraordinary contribution to the musical world. The Montreal Jazz Festival Spirit Award is in bronze. 2009: Named a Messenger of Peace by the United Nations. [ 218 ] March 6, 2010: Appointed a Commander of the Order of Arts and Letters by French Culture Minister Frédéric Mitterrand. Wonder had been due to be invested with this honor in 1981, but scheduling problems prevented this from happening. A lifetime achievement award was also given to Wonder on the same day, at France's biggest music awards. [ 219 ] June 2011: the Apollo Theater inducted Wonder into the Apollo Legends Hall of Fame. [ 220 ] [ 221 ] 2012: Recipient of the Billboard Icon Award. [ 222 ] 2013: Received the Music Makes One Global Ambassador Award from the outstanding music award ceremony of Asia and the World, Mnet Asian Music Awards. [ 223 ] 2014: Recipient of the Presidential Medal of Freedom. [ 224 ] 2014: Recipient of ASCAP Centennial Award. [ 225 ] 2016: Recipient of honorary key to Detroit, on the occasion of "Stevie Wonder Avenue" on the corner of the city's Milwaukee Avenue and Woodward Avenue. [ 226 ] 2021: Founding inductee of the Black Music and Entertainment Walk of Fame. [ 227 ] 2022: Recipient of the inaugural Icon Award from the Legal Defense Fund. [ 228 ] [ 229 ] [ 230 ] 2023: Awarded the freedom of Newcastle, UK, "in recognition of his activism for social and political causes". [ 231 ] [ 232 ] 2025: Awarded an Honorary Fellowship from the Royal Welsh College of Music & Drama. [ 233 ]
